question: Fosphenytoin different from phenytoin in which of the following-

options.opa: Can be used in absence seizures
options.opd: It is the drug of choice for myoclonic seizures

analysis: Fosphenytoin is a prodrug of phenytoin, primarily used for its better solubility and reduced local tissue irritation when given intravenously. Unlike phenytoin, which cannot be mixed with saline due to precipitation, fosphenytoin can be mixed with saline, making it more versatile for IV administration.
